assets.title: Off-grid Energy Station
assets.description: Original visual-only off-grid station combining a small wind turbine, tilted solar rack and utility cabinet on a 4.5x3 m base. Rotor_Runtime remains independent at Blender pivot (-1.35,0.23,3.01)m about +Y, equivalent glTF pivot (-1.35,3.01,-0.23)m about -Z. Stator_Runtime contains the fixed structures. Source components remain separately editable. No electrical connections, engineering specification, or functioning energy system is included.

assets.title: Small Stylized Wind Turbine
assets.description: Original low-poly small wind turbine visual asset, approximately 3.87 m tall. Rotor_Runtime is a separate mesh node with local pivot at Blender (0,-0.37,2.92)m and rotation axis +Y (glTF pivot (0,2.92,0.37)m, axis -Z); Stator_Runtime stays fixed. Editable source includes named rotor parts and a pivot marker. No animation, power simulation, or engineering design is provided.

assets.title: Tilted Solar Panel Rack
assets.description: Original low-poly solar panel rack visual module, 1.8 m panel width, 25 degree tilt and four separately grounded feet. Eight closed blue cells, frame, posts and feet remain editable in the source. Suggested row spacing at least 2 m along X; no engineering, power or solar exposure performance is implied.
